title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention- Logged-in user details on the Purview device onboarding page
description: This update introduces logged-in user details (user email) on the device onboarding page for Windows devices bringing it in line with the experience for MacOS devices. ​Admins can now see which user is currently signed in on a device, making It faster to confirm ownership and troubleshoot issues.
